title: Mad Alchemist in Storm
description: A bald, purple-skinned vampire-like alchemist in a dark gothic laboratory pours glowing green liquid from a flask onto a floating magical scroll. The scene is illuminated by lightning flashing through a large arched window during a violent thunderstorm, with red blood splattered across the marble desk covered in ancient books and potion bottles.
prompt: A sinister bald purple-skinned alchemist with pointed ears and a high-collared red and black robe stands in a gothic laboratory during a raging thunderstorm. He pours glowing green liquid from a glass flask onto a floating ancient scroll that drips with magic. Blood is splattered on the marble desk filled with old leather books, potion bottles, and scrolls. Lightning flashes through a large arched window behind him, dramatic lighting, dark fantasy atmosphere
